verified.gate_threshold_boundaries_and_persistenc: All five journey gates open at their locked threshold and stay open after a reduced percentage and save restore.
verified.journey_fixture: Known mission, page, Name, masjid and goal-tenth counts. 7 / 100 shows 7%, and 50 / 101 floors to 49%. The Journal uses the locked label.
verified.town_rules: First Jisra arrival records met_jisra. Unloaded hubs, closed gates and missing flags block travel. Open gates with no roads show the locked message.
verified.travel: Ilmara to and from Jisra 90 minutes, Jisra to Sahila 60 minutes, Sahila to Sukara 60 minutes, Sukara to Safira 330 minutes, and Safira to Ilmara 120 minutes.
verified.night: 19:59 and 04:40 permit departure. 20:00 and 04:39 block it. The map hides Go and both LOCK 32 east road buttons give the locked night message.
verified.jisra: Q14 keeps the bridge and masjid actions first, with Road map before prayer and the inn. R6 makes the map the exit when it is loaded.
